# Agentic Media Lab - source records

> One line per source record. Linked from https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/llms.txt because the cards did not fit there.

## Records

- [Meta: Rewarding Original Creators on Facebook (March 2026)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/about.fb.com__news__2026__03__rewarding-original-creators-on-facebook.md): source, quoted-primary. An agent pipeline that stitches stock or third-party clips with narration or captions is the pattern Meta names as unoriginal, so reach and ...
- [Six Million (Suspected) Fake Stars in GitHub: A Growing Spiral of Popularity Contests, Spams, and Malware](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2412.13459.md): source, quoted-primary. Star counts are the first filter most readers use to pick a video skill or renderer; this paper shows the signal is bought at scale and in ...
- [The Script is All You Need: ScripterAgent and DirectorAgent for dialogue-to-cinematic video](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2601.17737.md): source, quoted-primary. Its DirectorAgent rules (cut at shot boundaries, fit each segment to the model window with a 10% buffer, feed the last frame forward) are a ...
- [Co-Director: Agentic Generative Video Storytelling (arXiv 2604.24842)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2604.24842.md): source, quoted-primary. It is the closest paper to the reader's job, a 12-second multi-shot ad, and its judge rubric scores the hook in the first 1-2 seconds.
- [EntityBench: entity-consistent long-range multi-shot video benchmark](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2605.15199.md): source, quoted-primary. It shows that a high VBench-style score says little about whether the right character keeps appearing, which matters when picking a ...
- [See Before You Code: Learning Visual Priors for Spatially Aware Educational Animation Generation (OmniManim)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2605.15585.md): source, quoted-primary. It says the main failure of code-driven video cannot be seen by reading the code, which is the case for rendering frames and looking at ...
- [GroundShot: Entity-Grounded Shot Scheduling for multi-shot video (and GroundBench)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2606.20799.md): source, quoted-primary. It turns consistency into a scheduling and reference-management job that works with any reference-to-video model, including an open-weights ...
- [BBC Subtitle Guidelines](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/bbc.co.uk__accessibility__forproducts__guides__subtitles.md): source, quoted-primary. It is the one primary caption guide found that gives line width and font size for vertical video, which is the frame most agent-made shorts ...
- [Run Claude Code programmatically (claude -p)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/code.claude.com__docs__en__headless.md): source, quoted-primary. claude -p is what a system crontab, launchd job or CI runner calls; this page sets what such a run may do without a person.
- [Claude Code cloud scheduled tasks (formerly routines)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/code.claude.com__docs__en__routines.md): source, quoted-primary. The only option in this lane that keeps firing with the laptop shut and needs no server of your own, at the cost of no local files.
- [Claude Code: run prompts on a schedule (/loop) and compare scheduling options](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/code.claude.com__docs__en__scheduled-tasks.md): source, quoted-primary. The comparison table answers where each Claude Code schedule runs and what must stay on, in one place.
- [Instagram Platform - Content Publishing (with Reels specs)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/developers.facebook.com__docs__instagram-platform__content-publishing.md): source, quoted-primary. It gives the daily limit, the AI self-disclosure flag and the Reels encode targets for Instagram.
- [YouTube Data API - videos.insert and quota costs](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/developers.google.com__youtube__v3__docs__videos__insert.md): source, quoted-primary. It gives the daily upload ceiling and file limits a scheduled pipeline has to plan around.
- [YouTube Data API (v3) revision history](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/developers.google.com__youtube__v3__revision_history.md): source, quoted-primary. Most guides still say an unaudited YouTube project uploads private-only. Since November 2, 2026 that is no longer true, which makes YouTube ...
- [TikTok Content Posting API - Media Transfer Guide](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/developers.tiktok.com__doc__content-posting-api-media-transfer-guide.md): source, quoted-primary. These are the encode targets for a clip an agent renders for TikTok, from TikTok's own API page rather than a creator blog.
- [TikTok Content Posting API - Direct Post reference](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/developers.tiktok.com__doc__content-posting-api-reference-direct-post.md): source, quoted-primary. It holds the AI-label flag an agent should set on generated video and the error an unaudited client gets when the account is public.
- [TikTok Content Sharing Guidelines (Direct Post API)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/developers.tiktok.com__doc__content-sharing-guidelines.md): source, quoted-primary. This page decides whether a one-person pipeline can publish to TikTok publicly at all. Without an audit every post is private, and the ...
- [GitHub Actions: deployments and environments (required reviewers)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/docs.github.com__en__actions__reference__workflows-and-actions__deployments-and-environments.md): source, quoted-primary. Required reviewers are the built-in way to make a scheduled workflow stop and wait for a person before a publish or upload step.
- [GitHub Actions: events that trigger workflows (schedule)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/docs.github.com__en__actions__reference__workflows-and-actions__events-that-trigger-workflows.md): source, quoted-primary. A free scheduler for claude -p or codex exec that needs no machine of yours, with documented ways it fails to fire.
- [X API pay-per-usage pricing](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/docs.x.com__x-api__getting-started__pricing.md): source, quoted-primary. It answers what a post from an agent costs on X as of 2026-11-12, which replaced the fixed Basic and Pro tiers older guides describe.
- [Meta Ads Guide - Instagram Reels video ads](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/facebook.com__business__ads-guide__update__video__instagram-reels.md): source, quoted-primary. It is the only first-party page opened that states a vertical safe zone as numbers, which converts directly to a pixel check on a 1080x1920 ...
- [bb configuration reference](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/github.com__get-bb__bb__blob__main__docs__configuration.md.md): source, quoted-primary. It names the two settings that decide how unattended a scheduled bb run really is, and the one network setting that exposes command ...
- [bb automations: script runtime reference](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/github.com__get-bb__bb__blob__main__plugins__automations__skills__automations__references__script-runtime.md.md): source, quoted-primary. It states how a failed or overlapping scheduled run behaves, which decides whether a nightly render job can double-fire or silently stop.
- [HyperFrames skill: usage beacon and CLI telemetry](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/github.com__heygen-com__hyperframes__blob__main__skills__hyperframes__skill.md.md): source, quoted-primary. Installing the skill makes the agent report to HeyGen which skill ran, alongside CLI telemetry that is on unless switched off and is tied ...
- [HyperFrames issue 4435: parallel render workers capture a blank first frame](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/github.com__heygen-com__hyperframes__issues__4435.md): source, quoted-secondary. HyperFrames' skill tells the agent every render is identical; this report, with a repro and a named unmerged fix, shows parallel renders ...
- [X Automation rules](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/help.x.com__en__rules-and-policies__x-automation.md): source, quoted-primary. An agent that posts on a schedule is automation under these rules, and the page says what keeps such an account out of trouble.
- [Hermes Agent security: dangerous command approval](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/hermes-agent.nousresearch.com__docs__user-guide__security.md): source, quoted-primary. It states exactly what a cron job does when it hits a command that needs a person, and how approvals reach you in Slack, Telegram or ...
- [Codex non-interactive mode (codex exec)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/learn.chatgpt.com__docs__non-interactive-mode.md): source, quoted-primary. codex exec is the Codex counterpart of claude -p: what a cron job or CI runner calls when the reader's agent is Codex.
- [Netflix English (USA) Timed Text Style Guide](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/partnerhelp.netflixstudios.com__hc__en-us__articles__217350977-english-usa-timed-text-style-guide.md): source, quoted-primary. Every number here is a direct lint rule for an SRT or VTT file an agent writes: line length, characters per second, minimum and maximum ...
- [Remotion 5.0 migration: mandatory telemetry for licensed companies](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/remotion.dev__docs__5-0-migration.md): source, quoted-primary. An automated video pipeline on Remotion is the 'Automators' case, so upgrading to 5.0 means sending render events to Remotion or arranging ...
- [Remotion's Model Context Protocol (shut down)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/remotion.dev__docs__ai__mcp.md): source, quoted-primary. A vendor's own account of choosing skills over an MCP server for code-driven video.
- [skills.sh search results for 'ai-video-generation': cloned listings on new repos](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/skills.sh__api__search__ai-video-generation.md): source, quoted-primary. A reader who sorts video skills by installs will land on these copies first; the listing itself shows that install rank is not evidence of ...
- [skills.sh docs: how the leaderboard ranks skills and what audits cover](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/skills.sh__docs.md): source, quoted-primary. skills.sh install counts are the popularity number most video skills advertise; the directory itself says they come from CLI telemetry and ...
- [Snyk ToxicSkills: security audit of agent skills on ClawHub and skills.sh](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/snyk.io__blog__toxicskills-malicious-ai-agent-skills-clawhub.md): source, quoted-primary. Video skills come from the same registries; the audit puts a number on how many skills carry critical issues and shows that malicious ones ...
- [YouTube channel monetization policies (inauthentic content)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/support.google.com__youtube__answer__1311392.md): source, quoted-primary. An agent pipeline that makes many similar clips is the exact pattern this policy names, so it decides whether the channel can earn.
- [YouTube Help - Disclosing use of GenAI content](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/support.google.com__youtube__answer__14328491.md): source, quoted-primary. It is the only first-party page read here that says a platform reads C2PA, and it says a C2PA-triggered label cannot be removed.
- [YouTube recommended upload encoding settings](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/support.google.com__youtube__answer__1722171.md): source, quoted-primary. Each line maps to an ffmpeg flag, so an agent can check its export against YouTube's own list before upload.
- [YouTube Help - Add video thumbnails](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/support.google.com__youtube__answer__72431.md): source, quoted-primary. It is the target an agent should render a thumbnail to, and it says 16:9 thumbnails on vertical videos get replaced by a 4:5 crop in some ...
- [EBU R 128 s2 - Loudness in Streaming](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/tech.ebu.ch__files__live__sites__tech__files__shared__r__r128s2.pdf.md): source, quoted-primary. It is the only standards-body number found for a louder-than-broadcast streaming mix, the case most short clips fall into.
- [EBU R 128 - Loudness normalisation and permitted maximum level of audio signals](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/tech.ebu.ch__publications__r128.md): source, quoted-primary. It gives the two numbers a mix check needs, integrated loudness and true peak, plus a third for short clips, all measurable with ffmpeg ...
- [Vercel: AGENTS.md outperforms skills in our agent evals](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/vercel.com__blog__agents-md-outperforms-skills-in-our-agent-evals.md): source, quoted-primary. Many video skills assume the agent will load them when a video task comes up. Vercel measured that an agent often does not, which changes ...
- [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/w3.org__tr__wcag22.md): source, quoted-primary. It gives a pass or fail number for caption and title contrast and for flashing, which a frame-sampling check can test on a rendered clip.
- [TikTok Community Guidelines - Integrity and Authenticity (Edited Media and AIGC)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/www.tiktok.com__community-guidelines__en__integrity-authenticity.md): source, quoted-primary. It states when a generated clip must carry the AI label and what happens to unlabelled realistic AI content.

## Optional

- [TikTok Ads - Creative best practices for performance ads](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/ads.tiktok.com__help__article__creative-best-practices.md): source, quoted-primary. It is the only first-party page found that puts numbers on hook timing and on-screen text speed for short-form.
- [Artificial Analysis Video Arena: text-to-video and image-to-video leaderboards](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/artificialanalysis.ai__video__leaderboard__text-to-video.md): source, quoted-primary. It is the most used public ranking of hosted video models, and it shows rank ranges, so close models can be read as ties.
- [MovieAgent: Automated Movie Generation via Multi-Agent CoT Planning](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2503.07314.md): source, quoted-primary. An early multi-agent movie pipeline (March 2025) that later systems (ViMax, Co-Director) use as a baseline and beat.
- [VBench-2.0: benchmark suite for intrinsic faithfulness](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2503.21755.md): source, quoted-secondary. Many pipeline papers in this lane (CoAgent, MovieAgent) report VBench-family numbers, so a reader needs to know what they do and do not ...
- [ViStoryBench: benchmark suite for story visualization](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2505.24862.md): source, quoted-secondary. The standard test for the storyboard-image stage of a pipeline, before any video model runs; Google's Co-Director post reports results on ...
- [CoAgent: Collaborative Planning and Consistency Agent for Coherent Video Generation](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2512.22536.md): source, quoted-primary. It reports how often the verify-and-regenerate loop fires and how many retries it needs, which is the number to budget against.
- [WorldJen: end-to-end multi-dimensional benchmark for generative video models](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2605.03475.md): source, unverified. It names a specific weakness of VBench-2.0 that matters if a pipeline uses a VLM as its own checker: yes-bias and low-resolution frames.
- [Under the Hood of SKILL.md: Semantic Supply-chain Attacks on AI Agent Skill Registry](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2605.11418.md): source, quoted-primary. It shows that the description text of a skill decides whether an agent picks it and whether a registry blocks it, so a well-worded copy can ...
- [PRISM: benchmark for programmatic spatial-temporal reasoning](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2605.19382.md): source, quoted-secondary. It puts a number on why an agent must look at its Manim render: code that runs is often laid out wrong.
- [ViMax: Agentic Video Generation (arXiv 2606.07649)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2606.07649.md): source, quoted-primary. It names the fields a shot spec should carry and reports measured cost and quality for keyframe best-of-k, which sets a default for a ...
- [SGA: Plug&Play Geometric Verification for Educational Video Synthesis](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2607.18116.md): source, quoted-primary. A cheaper check than a VLM looking at rendered frames for the commonest Manim defect, overlapping labels, with runtime numbers.
- [C2PA FAQs (Content Credentials)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/c2pa.org__faqs.md): source, quoted-primary. YouTube states it labels content with C2PA metadata as AI and does not let the creator undo it, so a pipeline should know whether its ...
- [IBM Carbon Design System - Motion](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/carbondesignsystem.com__elements__motion__overview.md): source, quoted-primary. It states the rule that duration grows with distance or size and gives curves in both CSS and After Effects terms, which maps onto ...
- [Murch's Rule of Six (UT Austin RTF 318 course wiki)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/cloud.wikis.utexas.edu__wiki__spaces__rtf318__pages__80022510.md): source, quoted-secondary. It gives an ordered list a review step can use to decide which cut to keep when two rules conflict.
- [FCPXML Reference (Apple Developer)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/developer.apple.com__documentation__professional-video-applications__fcpxml-reference.md): source, quoted-primary. Final Cut Pro has no scripting API an agent can call, so writing FCPXML for File > Import > XML is the documented path, and several tools ...
- [Threads API - Posts](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/developers.facebook.com__docs__threads__posts.md): source, quoted-primary. Threads has the highest daily cap of the Meta surfaces and a 5-minute video limit, and its AI flag is documented with what it does not ...
- [Facebook Video API - Reels Publishing guide](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/developers.facebook.com__docs__video-api__guides__reels-publishing.md): source, quoted-primary. Facebook Page Reels have a lower daily cap and a shorter maximum length than Instagram Reels, which matters when one render goes to both.
- [Bluesky docs - Uploading Video](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/docs.bsky.app__docs__tutorials__video.md): source, quoted-primary. Bluesky needs no app review, but it does state account-level video limits without giving the numbers.
- [Mastodon docs - Posting (attachments) and Instance media configuration](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/docs.joinmastodon.org__user__posting.md): source, quoted-primary. Mastodon limits are set per server, so an agent should read them from the instance instead of hard-coding them.
- [X API - chunked media upload quickstart](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/docs.x.com__x-api__media__quickstart__media-upload-chunked.md): source, quoted-primary. It gives the video caps for a post on X and says they depend on the posting account's Premium status.
- [Fountain screenplay syntax](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/fountain.io__syntax.md): source, quoted-primary. An agent can write the script stage as a Fountain file the reader can open in screenwriting apps, with scenes and transitions parseable by ...
- [Using bb on multiple devices](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/github.com__get-bb__bb__blob__main__docs__multiple-devices.md.md): source, quoted-primary. It answers what must stay running for a bb schedule to fire: the server machine, awake.
- [HyperFrames vs Remotion research note (GenMotion)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/github.com__haxzie__genmotion__blob__main__docs__research__hyperframes-remotion.md.md): source, quoted-secondary. The only source found that says how HyperFrames capture differs on macOS, which is the reader's machine.
- [Material 3 motion tokens (material-web, _md-sys-motion.scss)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/github.com__material-components__material-web__blob__main__tokens__versions__latest__sass___md-sys-motion.scss.md): source, quoted-primary. An agent animating UI-style titles can use these values as named durations and curves instead of one default ease for everything.
- [Awesome Claude Video Skills (zhuyansen)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/github.com__zhuyansen__awesome-claude-video-skills.md): source, quoted-secondary. Covers the skill layer that this lane's research pipelines lack; its no-skill baseline is a useful reality check before installing a ...
- [X Authenticity policy (synthetic and manipulated media)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/help.x.com__en__rules-and-policies__authenticity.md): source, quoted-primary. It is X's only stated rule on AI-made media, and it names no labelling duty.
- [HyperFrames vs Remotion (HeyGen guide)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/hyperframes.heygen.com__guides__hyperframes-vs-remotion.md): source, quoted-secondary. The vendor of one side states where the other is better and admits HyperFrames fails quietly when its rules are broken. Read it as a party ...
- [Codex scheduled tasks (ChatGPT app)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/learn.chatgpt.com__docs__automations.md): source, quoted-primary. The Codex-side answer to scheduled agent runs with a review inbox, for readers who use Codex rather than Claude Code.
- [LinkedIn - Share on LinkedIn (self-serve) and Videos API](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/learn.microsoft.com__en-us__linkedin__consumer__integrations__self-serve__share-on-linkedin.md): source, quoted-primary. It separates the self-serve route a single developer can add today from the vetted route needed for company pages.
- [Pixabay API documentation](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/pixabay.com__api__docs.md): source, quoted-primary. An agent pulling b-roll from Pixabay has to follow these rules, and one of them restricts automated querying.
- [YouTube Help - Understand three-minute YouTube Shorts](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/support.google.com__youtube__answer__15424877.md): source, quoted-primary. It tells an agent the aspect ratio and length that make an upload land in the Shorts feed.
- [YouTube Help - Measure key moments for audience retention](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/support.google.com__youtube__answer__9314415.md): source, quoted-primary. It is YouTube's own definition of the intro window and tells a feedback loop which clips will get the report at all.
